single_scalar_transfer_copy_choices: Replacing one8-byte scalar transfer with one fixed copy adds one group and removes at most one scalar operation; it cannot improve the minimum. No one whole copy replaces different noncontiguous source values or independent operand calls.
method: exhaustive static integer partition check; not product/model/runtime execution or a performance counter
copy_source_and_destination: each substitution has complete source and received object; it cannot also retain its replaced scalar fields or share one of the four data-array copy groups
constructor_caveat: Metadata constructor field writes V02/V03 and V19..V22 are not made free by copying the constructed aggregate later. No contiguous pre-existing32-byte source is invented for distinct tuple fields.
not_global_impossibility: This only rejects the exact explored fragment under this source-bound field core; other structural designs require their own proof.
